content.comment_body: Hello everyone, Is it possible to activate an output on a [product_name] device using [product_name] in Excel? If so, how can this be done?
No, [product_name] is designed solely for data acquisition and does not support controlling device outputs.

analysis.insight_summary: A user asked about using [product_name] with Excel to control outputs on a [product_name] device. The response clarified that [product_name] only supports data logging and cannot be used to control outputs, highlighting a limitation in remote operational functionality and integration.
